news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹15.31 (up from ₹10.85 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹62.0b (up 23% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹3.60b (up 41% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 5.8% (up from 5.1% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 2.7%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 13%. Revenue is forecast to grow 52% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Auto Components industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 10% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 27% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
